name: error-diagnose
prompt: `python3 main.py` crashes — the traceback is saved in error.txt. Read the error, locate the actual bug in this small project, and fix the source so that `python3 main.py` prints exactly: hello PI! — do not modify error.txt.
verify: test "$(python3 main.py)" = "hello PI!" && grep -q Traceback error.txt
